description: Exclude existing worktrees, archives, scratch and personal templates from sealed framework generations.
changelog: Pactile update no longer traverses .pactile/worktrees, .pactile/worktree-archives, .pactile/tmp or .pactile/templates when building the managed generation. Existing user state is preserved.
notes: This fixes a 0.6.0 migration failure on projects with dependency links inside old worktrees. No one-time migration is needed.
